headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices face steep declines as markets log longest weekly losing streak in 25 years

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: En-masse selling by foreign institutional investors wiping out market capitalization
Surging global oil prices and persistent rate hike concerns triggering capital outflows
Indian benchmark shares facing 8 consecutive weeks of decline, the longest run in 25 years
Broad-based cyclical correction across Indian equity sectors leading to heightened volatility
whatHappening: Indian stock markets remain closed today, Saturday, 3 October 2026, for the weekend
IT majors including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech, and Tech Mahindra released Q2 FY27 earnings schedule
Reports indicate Jio Platforms is aiming for a $3.8 billion IPO opening on October 21
Benchmark indices ended lower in recent trading sessions as market volatility persisted
summary: Indian equities faced significant pressure in recent sessions, marking an eight-week consecutive losing streak. Sustained selling by foreign portfolio investors and macroeconomic headwinds like higher crude oil prices weighed heavily on sentiment. Meanwhile, major IT sector companies declared their Q2 earnings announcement dates as the market remains closed for the weekend.
